leadText: Sonny Dey (born Shannon Conley) is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of . She is also credited as Ursula Conlon.
plainText:
Sonny Dey (born Shannon Conley) is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of . She is also credited as Ursula Conlon.

==Pokémon roles==
Dey began to provide voices for during the ninth season, after and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series.
